+import pytest
+
+from jsonschema import Draft201909Validator, Draft202012Validator
+
+
+DRAFTS = [
+    (Draft201909Validator, "items"),
+    (Draft202012Validator, "prefixItems"),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+def test_all_item_errors_keep_order_and_indexes(Validator, positional):
+    subschema = {"type": "integer", "minimum": 10, "multipleOf": 3}
+    schema = {positional: [{}], "unevaluatedItems": subschema}
+    instance = ["covered", 5, 12, 7, "bad"]
+    errors = list(Validator(schema).iter_errors(instance))
+    assert len(errors) == 1
+    error = errors[0]
+    assert error.validator == "unevaluatedItems"
+    assert error.message == (
+        "Unevaluated items are not allowed (5, 7, 'bad' were unexpected)"
+    )
+    assert [child.validator for child in error.context] == [
+        "minimum", "multipleOf", "minimum", "multipleOf", "type",
+    ]
+    assert [list(child.path) for child in error.context] == [[1], [1], [3], [3], [4]]
+    assert [child.instance for child in error.context] == [5, 5, 7, 7, "bad"]
+    assert all(child.parent is error for child in error.context)
+    assert all(child.schema is subschema for child in error.context)
+    assert list(error.path) == []
+    assert list(error.schema_path) == ["unevaluatedItems"]
+    assert [list(child.schema_path) for child in error.context] == [
+        ["minimum"], ["multipleOf"], ["minimum"], ["multipleOf"], ["type"],
+    ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+def test_equal_failing_values_are_listed_once_per_position(Validator, positional):
+    schema = {"unevaluatedItems": {"minimum": 10, "multipleOf": 3}}
+    error, = Validator(schema).iter_errors([5, 5])
+    assert error.message == "Unevaluated items are not allowed (5, 5 were unexpected)"
+    assert [list(child.path) for child in error.context] == [[0], [0], [1], [1]]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+def test_nested_instance_and_schema_paths(Validator, positional):
+    subschema = {
+        "properties": {"n": {"minimum": 10, "multipleOf": 3}},
+    }
+    array_schema = {positional: [{}], "unevaluatedItems": subschema}
+    schema = {"properties": {"payload": array_schema}}
+    instance = {"payload": ["covered", {"n": 5}, {"n": 12}]}
+    error, = Validator(schema).iter_errors(instance)
+    assert list(error.path) == ["payload"]
+    assert [list(child.path) for child in error.context] == [[1, "n"], [1, "n"]]
+    assert [list(child.absolute_path) for child in error.context] == [["payload", 1, "n"], ["payload", 1, "n"]]
+    assert [child.validator for child in error.context] == ["minimum", "multipleOf"]
+    for child in error.context:
+        assert child.parent is error
+        assert list(child.absolute_schema_path) == [
+            "properties", "payload", "unevaluatedItems", "properties", "n",
+            child.validator,
+        ]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+def test_contains_coverage_is_preserved(Validator, positional):
+    schema = {
+        "contains": {"const": 5},
+        "unevaluatedItems": {"minimum": 10},
+    }
+    error, = Validator(schema).iter_errors([5, 7, 12])
+    assert error.message == "Unevaluated items are not allowed (7 was unexpected)"
+    child, = error.context
+    assert list(child.path) == [1]
+    assert child.validator == "minimum"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tail, message", [
+    ([7], "Unevaluated items are not allowed (7 was unexpected)"),
+    ([7, 8], "Unevaluated items are not allowed (7, 8 were unexpected)"),
+])
+def test_false_schema_diagnostics_are_unchanged(Validator, positional, tail, message):
+    schema = {positional: [{}], "unevaluatedItems": False}
+    error, = Validator(schema).iter_errors(["covered", *tail])
+    assert error.message == message
+    assert error.context == []
+    assert list(error.path) == []
+    assert list(error.schema_path) == ["unevaluatedItems"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+def test_successful_and_non_array_behavior_is_preserved(Validator, positional):
+    schema = {positional: [{}], "unevaluatedItems": {"minimum": 10, "multipleOf": 3}}
+    assert list(Validator(schema).iter_errors(["covered", 12, 15])) == []
+    assert list(Validator(schema).iter_errors({"not": "array"})) == []
+    assert list(Validator({"unevaluatedItems": True}).iter_errors([1, "x"])) == []
+    assert list(Validator({
+        "items": {"type": "integer"},
+        "unevaluatedItems": {"minimum": 10},
+    }).iter_errors([1, 2])) == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("Validator, positional", DRAFTS)
+def test_empty_schema_accepts_every_item(Validator, positional):
+    assert list(Validator({"unevaluatedItems": {}}).iter_errors([1, "x"])) == []
